title: sync.delta Body Schema
description: Body schema for sync.delta command topic. Carries a CRDT sync delta from the multi-device family sync subsystem. GREEN band only.

device_id.description: Source device identifier that produced this delta.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of delta creation (used for LWW resolution).

wall_clock_ms.description: Wall clock milliseconds for LWW conflict resolution.

conflict_id.description: Conflict identifier if this delta resulted from conflict resolution.

source_wal_pos.description: WAL position on source device for ordering.

merge_vector.description: Vector clock for causal ordering. Map of device_id to logical clock.

batch_id.description: Batch identifier if this delta is part of a multi-delta sync.
